meta.title: AgentBridge — MCP Stdio Subprocess Lifecycle & Teardown Workflow
meta.subtitle: Process Spawning, Stream Synchronization, Crash Detection & Force-Kill Fallback
meta.description: Lifecycle finite state machine and failure recovery workflow governing local MCP stdio processes. Illustrates transitions from DISCONNECTED through STARTING, active CONNECTED stream monitoring, process crash detection, graceful shutdown, and cross-platform termination fallbacks.

states.label: DISCONNECTED
states.description: Initial state. No child process exists. Calls to send_request raise ConnectorNotConnectedError.

states.label: Spawn Subprocess
states.description: Executes command with arguments array using asyncio.create_subprocess_exec (shell=False).

states.label: Process Spawned?
states.description: Verifies binary presence, permissions, and initial process launch within startup_timeout.

states.label: ERROR
states.description: Process failed to spawn (FileNotFoundError, PermissionError) or crashed unexpectedly.

states.label: CONNECTED
states.description: Transport is open and ready. Protocol reader is consuming stdout; writer is available on stdin.

states.label: Process Exit Monitor
states.description: Awaits proc.wait(). Detects unexpected crashes, captures exit codes, and fails in-flight requests.

states.label: Initiate Teardown
states.description: transport.close() requested. Transitions state to CLOSING and fails pending futures.

states.label: CLOSING
states.description: Teardown in progress. Inbound requests rejected; graceful exit procedure engaged.

states.label: Signal Stdin EOF
states.description: Closes stdin stream to notify server of orderly shutdown. Waits up to shutdown_timeout.

states.label: Exited Gracefully?
states.description: Checks if child process exited cleanly following stdin closure.

states.label: Send Terminate Signal
states.description: Sends SIGTERM (POSIX) or TerminateProcess (Windows). Waits up to kill_timeout.

states.label: Force Kill & Tree Cleanup
states.description: Sends SIGKILL (POSIX) or taskkill /F /T (Windows) to reclaim hung process and prevent zombies.

states.label: TERMINATED / DISCONNECTED
states.description: Process reaped, tasks cancelled, streams released. Transport returned to DISCONNECTED.
